Team Poképals 

 
 
 
 

 

 

Team Poképals (Japanese: ポケダンズ Pokédans) is the main in the animated specials Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness and Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness.

==History==
The two main Pokémon of the team are and . Piplup, however, is a human who was turned into a Pokémon, and was at first reluctant to be in an exploration team.

Although not part of Team Poképals, from the Wigglytuff Guild accompanied them on their first mission in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Darkness. Team Poképals also appeared alongside in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of the Sky - Beyond Time and Darkness, heading for Temporal Tower to face Primal Dialga.
